$meta.description: SF Symbol name -> Private Use Area codepoint (hex), for every symbol the Sous app uses. Apple assigns these; SF Pro renders the character. The local Figma plugin needs this table because figma.util.getSfSymbolCharacter exists only in Figma's remote (MCP) runtime, not in the desktop plugin API.
$meta.source: figma.util.getSfSymbolCharacter via the Figma MCP server, 2026-09-24
$meta.verified: checkmark = U+100185 matches the glyph in Apple's SFSymbolsFallback.otf on macOS
$meta.howToAdd: Add the symbol to the app first, then re-run the lookup through the Figma MCP server (one request covers any number of names) and paste the result here.
